extracted.name: Easy Black Beans and Tomatoes
extracted.description: This mixture of black beans and tomatoes is seasoned with lime juice, garlic, cumin, and chili powder to make a great sauce for fish tacos.
ingredient_lines: 1 (15 ounce) can black beans, rinsed and drained
1 teaspoon chili powder, or more to taste
1 teaspoon ground cumin, or more to taste
1 teaspoon garlic powder, or more to taste
instruction_lines: Stir black beans, tomatoes, lime juice, chili powder, cumin, and garlic powder together in a saucepan over medium heat; cook until the tomatoes soften, 10 to 15 minutes.
